note.en: All main-numbered ordinary Exercises and their subparts.

statement.ko: \(\sum_{n=0}^\infty c_n(x-a)^n\) 멱급수를 정의하고 식의 각 요소를 설명하라.
statement.en: \(\sum_{n=0}^\infty c_n(x-a)^n\) Define a power series and explain its components.

hint.ko: 일반항과 부분합을 구별하고 등비급수·소거합·일반항의 영 수렴 조건을 살펴본다.
hint.en: Distinguish terms from partial sums and examine geometric sums, telescoping, and the zero-term condition.

ko: \(a\text{ is the center},\quad c_n\text{ are fixed coefficients}\)
